top_signals.title: Bond Selloff Resumes as Oil Rises After Trump Spurns Iran Offer
top_signals.summary: A selloff in Treasuries resumed Monday as oil rallied after President Donald Trump rejected Iran’s latest proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, intensifying inflation concerns.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: BOJ rate hike in October is a real possibility, ex-official says
top_signals.summary: "I think the possibility of delaying the next hike until January or later is extremely low," says former executive director Kazuo Momma.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: The blue-collar AI job market is booming. Will data center backlash make it go bust?
top_signals.summary: The public has soured on AI data centers and states are slowing development, but for HVAC, plumbing, welding, and electrical workers, it's been a jobs boom.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Power cuts and rubble: Millions come home to find Sudan’s capital unlivable
top_signals.summary: Once a major African capital that was home to more than 8 million people, Khartoum is a shell of its former self.
